contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP M IVL PHILLIPVS AVG ; R/ AEQVITAS S-C

Extremely worn sestertius of Philipp I (244-249) dating from AD244-247. Obverse description: laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP M IVL PHILLIPVS AVG. Reverse description: Aequitas - standing centre, facing left, holding scales and cornucopia. S-C across fields. Reverse inscription: AEQVITAS S-C. Minted in Rome, probably this issue, of 244-47:…
